children: Nifty 50 began today’s session with a gap-up at 23,352 versus yesterday’s close of 23,329. The index is now hovering around 23,375, up 0.2 per cent.

The advance/decline ratio of Nifty 50 now stands at 30/20, showing a positive bias. Bajaj Finance (up 2.6 per cent) and Bajaj Finserv (up 2 per cent) are the top gainers. Whereas TCS and Wipro, down 0.75 per cent each, are the top losers.
Among the sectors, Nifty Metal (up 1.1 per cent) is the top gainer whereas Nifty IT (down 0.6 per cent) is the weakest sector.
Overall, the recovery has in the last few sessions lack strength and so, as it stands, the likelihood of Nifty 50 and Nifty futures resuming the decline is high.

Even though the underlying Nifty 50 index opened today’s session higher than yesterday’s close, Nifty (Sep) futures began today’s session lower at 23,381 against Tuesday’s close of 23,395. The contract is now trading at 23,400.

The contract has a resistance at 23,425 and 23,480. Only a decisive breach of the latter can add strength to the bulls, potentially leading to more gains. In this case, Nifty futures can rally to 23,600 quickly.
On the other hand, a resumption in the downtrend from the current level can drag Nifty futures to 23,200.
Short Nifty (Sep) futures now at 23,400. Target and stop-loss can be 23,200 and 23,500 respectively.

title: Nifty Prediction Today – September 23, 2026: Nifty futures: Struggles to recover
